 Niqab Shafiq to Aaryavir Sehwag, out Caught by Mohammad Sayyam!! Aaryavir Sehwag has holed out to deep mid-wicket. Niqab Shafiq roars with a thigh-five and mouths "come on" multiple times. He punches the air as well. Sayyam takes a good low flat catch diving forward and then flings the ball away. He too is pumped. The Pakistani supporters in the crowd are thrilled as well. It's a length delivery just outside off, Sehwag looks to break free, sinks low to sweep, off the thick inner half of the bat and Sayyam is well in from the fence. India in all sorts of trouble here. Aaryavir Sehwag c Mohammad Sayyam b Niqab Shafiq 22(40) [4s-1 6s-1] 16.2 Niqab Shafiq to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, flat good length on off, Aaryavir Sehwag goes on the back foot and punches it wide of the short mid-wicket diving to his left 16.1 Niqab Shafiq to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, almost a caught and bowled. Aaryavir Sehwag comes down the track and is not to the pitch of the ball, drives and it's just short of the bowler 15.5 Rizwanullah to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, short of length on the body, Aaryavir Sehwag again is hurried for pace, goes on the back foot to help it down and he gloves it behind square on the leg-side. Some words between the batter and the bowler, Sehwag shakes his head 15.4 Rizwanullah to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, that's a fine delivery. Rizwanullah follows-through and has a stare at Aaryavir Sehwag. It's a rising short of length delivery outside off, Sehwag walks and looks to punch, it gets big on him and he is lucky not to outside edge that 15.3 Rizwanullah to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, short on leg-stump, Aaryavir Sehwag ducks 14.2 Niqab Shafiq to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, outside off stump, Aaryavir guides to the off-side 14.1 Niqab Shafiq to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, flighted delivery, pushed to the off-side with one hand 13.4 Rizwanullah to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, oh taps it wide of mid-on and sets off on a risky run. A direct-hit would have been curtains 12.6 6 Hasnain Abbas Dar to Aaryavir Sehwag, SIX , lofted straight down the ground and this 12-run over will be welcomed by India . They were not able to score and now they have got a big over finally. Again in the slot, Aaryavir gets under it and smashes it for the first maximum of the day 12.2 Hasnain Abbas Dar to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, opens the face of the bat and guides it down to backward point 12.1 Hasnain Abbas Dar to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, keeper up to the stumps, Aaryavir defends this length delivery 10.6 Ali Raza to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, short delivery, Aaryavir Sehwag sits under it. The bowler runs all the way to the batter and gives him a long stare. Aaryavir makes extended eye contact with him till the bowler walks back. No words though! 9.6 Mohammad Sayyam to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, lays bat on ball and defends this short of length delivery to cover-point 9.5 Mohammad Sayyam to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, now he wanted to play at it and then bailed out to miss this short of length delivery angling away 9.4 Mohammad Sayyam to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, play and a miss again ! Aaryavir is having trouble with the left-armer's angle across him. Tries to drive throught he off-side and misses 9.3 Mohammad Sayyam to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, he's tried to give himself some room on the drive for the second time to Mohammad Sayyam and missed it again . Mohammad Sayyam could not believe how that escaped the off stump 9.2 Mohammad Sayyam to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, fullish delivery, Aaryavir defends off the front foot 9.1 Mohammad Sayyam to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, fullish delivery on the stumps, Aaryavir defends towards backward point 8.1 Ali Raza to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, short of length delivery, Aaryavir dabs it to deep backward point 7.6 Mohammad Sayyam to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, very full delivery on the leg stump, Aaryavir flicks to deep square leg 7.5 Mohammad Sayyam to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, fullish delivery outside off stump, Aaryavir leans forward and drives towards cover 5.6 Mohammad Sayyam to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, lets this length delivery come to his bat and defends with an angled bat to backward point 5.5 Mohammad Sayyam to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, this time he gets right behind the line to defend this length delivery 5.4 Mohammad Sayyam to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, beaten ! Aaryavir went leg-side slightly to go himself some room on this cover-drive, in the process he lost shape on the shot and the bottom hand came off. Wasn't far away from the off stump as well 5.3 Mohammad Sayyam to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, lets this length delivery go past him to the keeper as it was outside off stump 5.2 Mohammad Sayyam to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, short of length delivery, Aaryavir manages to defend off the back foot 5.1 Mohammad Sayyam to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, oh leading edge as he gets squared up . Short of a length delivery moving away, Aaryavir wanted to flick, but the ball left him late and surprised him. Thnakfully for the batter it didn't carry to the bowler 4.5 Ali Raza to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, uppishly guides this short of length delivery to third man 4.4 4 Ali Raza to Aaryavir Sehwag, FOUR , that is a brilliant straight drive and look at him hold the high elbow pose . Tells you he enjoyed that so much. The bowler tried to do the classic fast bowler's response of following up a bumper with a full delivery, but Aaryavir was ready for it and gave the full face of the bat 4.3 Ali Raza to Aaryavir Sehwag, 2 runs, goes for a rushed pull, didn't middle the ball, but managed to clear mid-on. Short delivery, looks like Aaryavir wanted to duck initially and then realized he can play the pull, managed to connect decently well 3.6 Mohammad Sayyam to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, play and a miss again ! Again just beaten on the angle going across him, this time to a good length delivery 3.5 Mohammad Sayyam to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, fullish and on the stumps, Aaryavir knocks it confidently to mid-wicket 3.4 Mohammad Sayyam to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, beaten ! Aaryavir gets forward this time and looks to drive this full ball angling across him, he misses it on the angle 2.6 Ali Raza to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, this time he makes contact on the drive, but the bottom hand comes off so the ball goes straight to point. That was a hit me ball and Aaryavir will be disappointed he didn't get the placement right 2.5 Ali Raza to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, oh wants to drive on the rise and misses . Good length delivery wide of off stump, Aaryavir throws his hands at it without going fully forward at it again and gets beaten 2.4 Ali Raza to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, second slip added before this ball. Ali Raza bowls a length delivery just around the off stump, Aaryavir defends from the crease off the inner half of the bat 2.3 Ali Raza to Aaryavir Sehwag, no run, short of length delivery outside off stump, Aaryavir taps it to backward point 1.2 Mohammad Sayyam to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, this time Aaryavir gets right behind the line and knocks this length delivery off the inner half of the bat through backward square leg 0.5 Ali Raza to Aaryavir Sehwag, 1 run, inside edge past the stumps , Aaryavir didn't fully come forward as he wanted to drive this fullish delivery through cover, ball takes the edge and escapes to fine leg.
